# Zippy - macOS Zip Utility

## Project Overview
Zippy is a native macOS application built with Swift and SwiftUI for managing zip archives.

## Features
- ✅ View/preview zipped content (list files and folders)
- ✅ Unzip/extract archives
- ✅ Create zip archives with basic storage compression

## Project Structure
- `Sources/` - Swift source files
  - `ZippyApp.swift` - Main app entry point
  - `Views/` - SwiftUI views
  - `Models/` - Data models
  - `Utilities/` - Zip operation utilities
- `Package.swift` - Swift Package Manager configuration
- `README.md` - Documentation

## Development Notes
- Uses Swift 5.9+
- Targets macOS 13.0+
- SwiftUI for UI
- ZipFoundation framework for zip operations
